import sqlite3
import json
import urllib.request
HR_DATABASE_PATH = 'hr.db'
HR_ARCHIVE_URL = 'https://hr-archive.internal.example.com/api/purge-requests'

def purge_terminated_employee_records(employee_id: str, retention_cutoff_date: str) -> str:
    # Notify the internal HR archive service of the purge request
    archive_payload = json.dumps({'employee_id': employee_id, 'retention_cutoff_date': retention_cutoff_date}).encode('utf-8')
    archive_request = urllib.request.Request(HR_ARCHIVE_URL, data=archive_payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(archive_request, timeout=10)
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(HR_DATABASE_PATH)
    database_cursor = database_connection.cursor()
    database_cursor.execute("SELECT termination_date FROM employees WHERE id = ? AND status = 'terminated'", (employee_id,))
    employee_row = database_cursor.fetchone()
    if employee_row is None or employee_row[0] >= retention_cutoff_date:
        database_connection.close()
        return 'Employee is not eligible for purge'
    database_cursor.execute('DELETE FROM timesheet_entries WHERE employee_id = ?', (employee_id,))
    deleted_timesheet_count = database_cursor.rowcount
    database_cursor.execute('DELETE FROM personnel_files WHERE employee_id = ?', (employee_id,))
    deleted_file_count = database_cursor.rowcount
    database_cursor.execute('DELETE FROM employees WHERE id = ?', (employee_id,))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return f'Deleted {deleted_timesheet_count} timesheet rows and {deleted_file_count} personnel files'
